description: SUM Execution Value phía mua theo từng Security Type Group — **[SửA 2026-09-28]** đổi cơ chế phân loại STOCK/BOND/FUND_CERT từ Market_Id_Code sang JOIN MDDS security_trading_snapshot.stock_tp_code (lấy dòng trading_time mới nhất/ngày qua ROW_NUMBER), đồng bộ Câu lệnh tham khảo BA hiện hành và pattern đã duyệt ở Fact Securities Foreign Trading Snapshot (Nhóm 1/2, sửa 2026-09-25) — xem Ghi chú thiết kế HLD Nhóm 14, O_NDTNN_35
etl_logic:
WITH sts AS (SELECT security_trading_snapshot.symbol, security_trading_snapshot.isin_code, security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt, security_trading_snapshot.stock_tp_code, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY security_trading_snapshot.symbol, security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt ORDER BY security_trading_snapshot.trading_time DESC) AS rn FROM security_trading_snapshot WHERE security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt = :etl_date) → INNER JOIN sts ON sts.rn = 1 AND sts.trading_dt = securities_trade.trade_dt AND ((securities_trade.src_stm_code = 'ORDERTRADE_TRADE_BOOK_HOSE' AND sts.symbol = securities_trade.security_symbol_code) OR (securities_trade.src_stm_code = 'ORDERTRADE_TRADE_BOOK_HNX' AND sts.isin_code = securities_trade.security_symbol_code)) → SUM(CASE WHEN securities_trade.buy_foreign_investor_tp_code IN ('10','20') AND sts.stock_tp_code = '1' THEN securities_trade.execution_val ELSE 0 END) WHERE securities_trade.trade_dt = :etl_date GROUP BY securities_trade.trade_dt -- STOCK (sửa 2026-09-28, thay Market_Id_Code bằng JOIN Security Trading Snapshot, đồng bộ pattern đã duyệt ở Fact Securities Foreign Trading Snapshot Nhóm 1/2, xem O_NDTNN_35)
UNION ALL WITH sts AS (SELECT security_trading_snapshot.symbol, security_trading_snapshot.isin_code, security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt, security_trading_snapshot.stock_tp_code, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY security_trading_snapshot.symbol, security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt ORDER BY security_trading_snapshot.trading_time DESC) AS rn FROM security_trading_snapshot WHERE security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt = :etl_date) → INNER JOIN sts ON sts.rn = 1 AND sts.trading_dt = securities_trade.trade_dt AND ((securities_trade.src_stm_code = 'ORDERTRADE_TRADE_BOOK_HOSE' AND sts.symbol = securities_trade.security_symbol_code) OR (securities_trade.src_stm_code = 'ORDERTRADE_TRADE_BOOK_HNX' AND sts.isin_code = securities_trade.security_symbol_code)) → SUM(CASE WHEN securities_trade.buy_foreign_investor_tp_code IN ('10','20') AND sts.stock_tp_code = '2' THEN securities_trade.execution_val ELSE 0 END) WHERE securities_trade.trade_dt = :etl_date GROUP BY securities_trade.trade_dt -- BOND
UNION ALL WITH sts AS (SELECT security_trading_snapshot.symbol, security_trading_snapshot.isin_code, security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt, security_trading_snapshot.stock_tp_code, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY security_trading_snapshot.symbol, security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt ORDER BY security_trading_snapshot.trading_time DESC) AS rn FROM security_trading_snapshot WHERE security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt = :etl_date) → INNER JOIN sts ON sts.rn = 1 AND sts.trading_dt = securities_trade.trade_dt AND ((securities_trade.src_stm_code = 'ORDERTRADE_TRADE_BOOK_HOSE' AND sts.symbol = securities_trade.security_symbol_code) OR (securities_trade.src_stm_code = 'ORDERTRADE_TRADE_BOOK_HNX' AND sts.isin_code = securities_trade.security_symbol_code)) → SUM(CASE WHEN securities_trade.buy_foreign_investor_tp_code IN ('10','20') AND sts.stock_tp_code IN ('3','6') THEN securities_trade.execution_val ELSE 0 END) WHERE securities_trade.trade_dt = :etl_date GROUP BY securities_trade.trade_dt -- FUND_CERT ('3','6' nguyên văn Câu lệnh tham khảo BA `stocktype IN (3,6)` — giá trị '6' chưa được xác nhận độc lập qua Fact Nhóm 1/2 (chỉ xác nhận '1','2','3'), xem O_NDTNN_35)
UNION ALL SUM(CASE WHEN securities_trade.buy_foreign_investor_tp_code IN ('10','20') THEN securities_trade.execution_val ELSE 0 END) WHERE securities_trade.trade_dt = :etl_date GROUP BY securities_trade.trade_dt -- TOTAL (không JOIN Security Trading Snapshot, SUM toàn bộ Securities Trade)
